I have had this cashew plot for many years, and I know these trees well. I will put some manure around the trunks because the soil here in Mtwara is sandy and I own this land, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer — one bag costs too much for only 0.43 hectares and the agro-dealer is far. My wife and children will do the weeding and harvesting ourselves; we do not have cash to pay workers for such a small plot.
